title: House Robber II
kidExplanation: Same treasure houses, but now they form a circle — first and last are neighbors too.

thinkingSteps.title: Aha insight
thinkingSteps.body: The key idea for solving this problem is to recognize that it's an extension of the House Robber I problem (LeetCode 198). Since we cannot rob adjacent houses, we have two scenarios: 1. Rob the first house and exclude the last house. 2. Exclude the first house and consider robbing the last house. We calculate the maximum amount for both scenarios using the House Robber I algorithm and return the maximum of the two results.
